cim_eredeti: Video | French New Language For AI? Macron Wants French To Become A Key Language For Artificial Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti: French President Emmanuel Macron has called for French to become one of the primary languages used to train future artificial intelligence systems, arguing that linguistic diversity must be protected in the AI age. Speaking at the 20th Francophonie Summit in Cambodia, Macron warned against a future where powerful AI tools are developed around only a handful of dominant languages. He stressed that language diversity is essential for culture, democracy and access to technology.
